item.title: WATCH: Trump compares US strike on Iran to Pearl Harbor
item.summary: President Donald Trump on Thursday, seated next to Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in the Oval Office, compared U.S. strikes against Iran to Japan's attack on Pearl Harbor during World War II.

item.title: WATCH: Meteorite hunter chases down Ohio meteor hit
item.summary: Roberto Vargas, a meteorite hunter, joins ABC News Live from his car as he attempts to chase down the exact site a meteor caused a boom over Ohio in hopes of finding any rare space rocks left behind.

item.title: LIVE: ABC News Live
item.summary: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: WATCH: New York State trooper involved in chain reaction crash during traffic stop
item.summary: The trooper in Mamaroneck was injured during a traffic stop when a SUV slammed into his patrol car, pushing it into another vehicle and hitting him. The incident is under investigation.

item.title: WATCH: Rhode Island high school hockey team wins state title after deadly ice rink shooting
item.summary: David Muir reports on young hockey star Colin Dorgan – who lost his family in the deadly Rhode Island ice rink shooting – scoring a key goal in the game to help his team win in quadruple overtime.

item.title: 2,200 more Marines, 3 Navy ships likely headed to Middle East: Officials
item.summary: Three Navy ships carrying 2,200 Marines is likely headed to the Middle East, two U.S. officials told ABC News.

item.title: Chuck Norris, action star and martial artist, dies at 86
item.summary: His family announced his passing on Friday.

item.title: CBS News shutters storied radio news service after nearly a century, ending an era
item.summary: CBS News says it's shutting down its radio news service after nearly a century of operation as part of a round of layoffs at the company

item.title: WATCH: Ultimate Friday buzzer-beater
item.summary: Caden Farrare, 11, launched a no-look shot with his back to the rim as time was running out during a game between fifth graders at CMIT Elementary in Laurel, Maryland.

item.title: WATCH: Epstein investigation in UK asks for United States cooperation
item.summary: ABC’s Aaron Katersky sits down with the head of Scotland Yard, Sir Mark Rowley, for help with investigating former Prince Andrew.
